messages:
Jordan (SRE): Getting alerts from customers — looks like pages for service-payments didn't go through. PD shows incidents created but on-call didn't get a page. :eyes:
Maya (Oncall): I didn't get anything. I saw a PD incident but no phone page.
Jordan (SRE): Same. Checking incidentbot logs now.
inc-bot: Failed to deliver page to +1-555-0100: webhook 403 signature mismatch
Lee (Infra): 403 on webhook? Recent proxy header rotation happened ~1h ago during deploy.
Riley (Eng): Confirm — we rotated the proxy signing header as part of cert refresh. Could be related.
Jordan (SRE): Stack trace from inc-bot:
```
POST /webhook/pager 403 {"error":"signature_verification_failed","header":"x-inc-sign"}
```
Maya (Oncall): Root cause hypothesis: proxy stripped or renamed x-inc-sign so PD webhook validation failed.
Sam (Customer Success): Potential customer impact: 2 customers reported delayed incident awareness (~10-12m). Escalated to tier-2.
Jordan (SRE): Actions: 1) enable manual paging via ops-runbook 2) revert proxy header rename 3) restart incidentbot 4) inform CS for customer comms
Lee (Infra): Reverting proxy config now.
Lee (Infra): Revert applied; proxy logs show x-inc-sign forwarded again.
Jordan (SRE): Restarting inc-bot: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/incidentbot -n infra`
inc-bot: Restart successful, 0.3s startup
inc-bot: Delivered page to +1-555-0100 (id: pgr_9837)
Maya (Oncall): I got a test page. :thumbsup:
Sam (Customer Success): Contacted affected customers, they confirmed they received the manual notification and follow-ups. No SLA breach confirmed yet but they're unhappy.
Riley (Eng): Will add a proxy integration test to CI that verifies x-inc-sign pass-through.
Jordan (SRE): Runbook note: during header rotations ensure proxy preserves x-inc-sign and inc-bot verifies header presence, otherwise fallback to signed payload.
Maya (Oncall): Oncall handoff: I'm passing to next shift but leaving a pager note about temporary manual paging steps.
Jordan (SRE): Postmortem owners: Jordan + Lee + Riley + Sam. Target write-up by EOD tomorrow. Action items: fix proxy rotation script, add CI test, add monitoring for webhook 4xx spikes.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll draft customer-facing blurb for impacted accounts.
Riley (Eng): Also adding a dashboard alert: inc-bot delivery 4xx rate > 1% in 5m.
Jordan (SRE): Thanks all — closing this slack thread once postmortem is created. :white_check_mark:
